remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. The design is original but the surface has been reworked by another hand. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: relationship of image to cat. no. 780.
titles.title: Untitled (Jawbone and Fungus)

description: In this white and gray composition, an animal's jawbone stretches across the bottom of the paper. Above the jawbone, softly shaded forms float like wisps of smoke.
title: Untitled (Jawbone and Fungus)
